takes.title: Walk Forward at a Steady Pace
takes.actionDescription: Already mid-stride, the performer walks forward with an easy arm swing and remains in stride through the last frame.

takes.title: Walk Forward with Longer Strides
takes.actionDescription: The performer is already walking when the take opens and takes long, even strides with a pronounced arm swing. The take ends mid-stride.

takes.title: Hold a Bent-Knee Pose with Arms Raised
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a wide stance with bent knees, one forearm extended outward and the other hand near the head. The pose is essentially unchanged across the two captured frames.

takes.title: Gesture in Place, Bend, and Reach Overhead
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands nearly in place, gestures with both hands, folds forward at the waist and straightens, then reaches overhead and continues gesturing at chest and face height. The arms lower at the end.

takes.title: Jog Forward with Quick Strides
takes.actionDescription: The performer is already jogging as the clip opens, taking quick alternating strides with bent elbows. The motion ends mid-stride.

takes.title: Jump and Steady the Landing
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer crouches, swings the arms, and springs upward. They absorb the landing through bent knees and make a small adjustment before standing still.

takes.sourceDescription: bend over, scoop up, rise, lift arm
takes.title: Reach Low and Lift an Arm
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly bends or crouches to reach toward the floor, then straightens and brings one hand up toward the face or overhead. The movement finishes upright with the arms lowered.

takes.title: Long Jump Forward
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer dips and swings the arms, leaps forward, and lands in a deep crouch. They straighten and settle into standing.

takes.title: Walk and Turn Left
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride, takes several forward steps, then turns left roughly a quarter turn and keeps walking through the final frame.

takes.title: Walk and Turn Right
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride, takes several forward steps, then turns right roughly a quarter turn and keeps walking through the final frame.
